title: Coinductive Interaction Trees using QPFs
abstract: Formalizes coinductive interaction trees as the M-type of a polynomial functor (via Mathlib QPFs), proving the lawful functor and monad structure, a bisimulation equality coinciding with propositional equality, and iteration and effect-handler interpretation combinators, supported by a vendored parameterized-coinduction (Paco) library.

informal.Lean4Itree.ITree: Defines the coinductive interaction tree as the final coalgebra (M-type) of the interaction-tree polynomial functor.
informal.Lean4Itree.ITree.IEq: Defines bisimulation equality between interaction trees as a coinductive fixed point.
informal.Lean4Itree.ITree.ieq_iff_eq: Proves that bisimulation equality of interaction trees coincides with propositional equality.
informal.Lean4Itree.ITree.bind_assoc: Proves associativity of monadic bind for interaction trees, part of the LawfulMonad instance.
informal.Lean4Itree.ITree.iter: Defines the iteration combinator producing an interaction tree from a step function.
informal.Lean4Itree.ITree.interp: Defines interpretation of an interaction tree against an effect handler into an arbitrary iterable monad.
informal.Lean4Itree.plfp_acc: Proves the accumulation principle for the parameterized least fixed point underlying the Paco coinduction library.
